name: hat_on
about: Brown hat parented to a head
code:
def hat_on(ch, color='#6a4a2a'):
    root = empty('hat_' + ch.name, (0, 0, 0), parent=ch.head)
    m = mat('hat_brown', hexc(color), 0.6)
    cyl('hat_top_' + ch.name, 0.5, 0.55, (0, 0, 0.88), m, 16, parent=root)
    cyl('hat_brim_' + ch.name, 0.9, 0.08, (0, 0, 0.62), m, 16, parent=root)
    return root

source.title: The Town That Lives in a Plane
